caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped plate with a white base color, featuring a decorative border around the rim. The border consists of a repeating pattern of small yellow and orange flowers connected by thin, curving lines, evenly spaced around the edge. The plate is centrally positioned within a lightly drawn rectangular frame. Below the plate, there is a smaller, sketched schematic representation of the plate showing the top and side views, along with a round stamp labeled "IDEAL PORCELAINE" and a handwritten signature, "A. Sucek." The background of the drawing is light beige, and the entire image is rendered in soft, delicate tones with a focus on the detailed floral pattern.
title: Platter
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
